app.local: Academic data stays on this device.
app.memory: Storage unavailable. Changes last only for this visit. Export a backup.
app.error: Could not save. Reload to review the latest local profile.
app.version: Historical curriculum: Portal 20192. Verify your examination regulations.
app.welcome: Start with what you have already passed. Then find your next semester.
common.unavailable: The WS 2026/27 timetable is not published here. Your progress and academic priorities still work. Choose historical data to explore groups.
progress.title: Know where you stand.
progress.subtitle: Record outcomes individually. A passed lab stays passed when an exam needs another attempt.
progress.markStarted: Mark all unreviewed components as not started
progress.milestoneNote: First-year checklist is advisory. Formal internship admission and exceptions need confirmation from HAW.
profile.diff: This backup will replace progress, preferences and saved schedules on this device.
profile.invalid: Invalid or incompatible profile. Your current data was not changed.
profile.clearConfirm: Delete progress, preferences and saved schedules from this device? Export a backup first if you need it.
advisor.title: Make your next move.
advisor.subtitle: Academic priorities first. Exact groups second. Every recommendation has a reason.
advisor.bounded: Search budget reached. These are the best found plans, not a proven global optimum.
advisor.identical: Some plans are identical because of availability or your limits.
advisor.noPlans: No feasible plan found. Review progress, workload limits and available data.
advisor.stale: Your inputs changed. Generate a fresh plan before applying it.
advisor.whatIf: If every planned component is passed
advisor.potential: Potential module credits · conditional on passing
advisor.noRemote: Explanation uses the same deterministic local reasons. No AI service is needed.
reason.completion: Can complete the remaining module requirements
reason.examOnly: Existing practical work is already passed
reason.notOffered: No usable offering in this term
reason.blocked: A hard prerequisite is unmet or unverified
reason.recommendedMissing: Recommended preparation or assessment prerequisite remains open
reason.examDateUnknown: Exam offering/date is unverified. This is preparation, not exam registration.
reason.historical: Historical dates are a preview, not a current semester promise
schedule.title: Your week, arranged.
schedule.subtitle: Choose courses and entire parallel groups. Inspect overlaps across the full term before exporting.
schedule.empty: No sessions in this week. Choose modules or use an Advisor plan.
schedule.quarantine: Source conflict: this group is excluded from Advisor plans until verified.
schedule.undated: Undated exams do not appear in the calendar. Check HAW registration and exam notices.
schedule.filterNotice: Filters change only this view. Term-wide conflicts still include all selected sessions.
map.title: See the bigger picture.
map.subtitle: Explore your degree, requirements and the opportunities ahead.
map.legend: Solid edges: hard rules. Dashed edges: recommendations. Dotted edges: advisory milestone membership.
import.title: Import a transcript locally
import.preview: Preview support · review every detected row
import.note: Text-based PDF only, up to 10 MB. Processing stays in your browser. Real HAW layout coverage has not yet been verified with a representative anonymized sample.
import.empty: No usable text detected. For scanned or unsupported documents, enter progress manually.
import.error: PDF could not be read. Password-protected, invalid or very large files need manual input.
import.duplicate: Multiple rows target the same component. Resolve duplicates before applying.
pulse.title: Community Pulse
pulse.disabled: Community Pulse is offline. An active backend and private configuration are needed; academic planning works independently.
pulse.privacy: Only your explicit course vote is sent. Never your academic profile or schedule.
pulse.small: Fewer than 5 responses. Aggregates are hidden.
pulse.error: Community request failed. Try again later.
reason.planOmission: Omitted by this plan's academic comparison, workload/lab caps or dated group conflicts. Adjust preferences to explore another combination.
reason.conditionalCollision: One required session overlaps by at most 30 minutes. This preview cannot be applied. Resolve the exact group/date collision and regenerate a feasible plan; acknowledging it is insufficient.
pwa.offline: Offline · academic tools run locally; displayed term data may be historical.
pwa.update: New version available. Reload after saving or exporting your profile.
milestone.exception: Admission exceptions require individual HAW confirmation.
